purpose: Capture the user's delegated approval direction while preserving non-bypassable safety boundaries.
consensus_can_approve: x2 build-use tasks inside approved repo scope
watcher, notifier, and runner improvements that avoid destructive behavior
consensus_cannot_approve: raw route ID or callable ID publication
reset, rebase, force-push, or history rewrite
empirical closure or canon-promotion claims without exact evidence artifacts

approval_test.safe: The bundle avoids destructive, private, external, and irreversible actions.
approval_test.feasible: The bundle can be executed with currently available tools and existing lanes.
approval_test.useful: The bundle improves continuity, orchestration, evidence quality, or phase execution.
approval_test.evidence_bound: Claims are backed by receipts, source ledgers, tests, or explicit blockers.
approval_test.reversible: Changes are repo-scoped and can be audited through git history.

publication_rules: commit and push to both omega branches only after drift check

verbatim_retention_position.default_until_guard_exists: sanitized excerpts, metrics, hashes, and marker receipts rather than raw lane text
